title: Create Mod: FPS Boosted
description: A highly optimized, technical Minecraft modpack centered around the Create Mod, engineered for maximum FPS and smooth gameplay.
body:
**# ⚙️ Welcome to [Create Mod: FPS Boosted]!**

This modpack is a carefully curated, performance-first experience built entirely around the **Create Mod**. If you love building massive factories, moving contraptions, and automated trains, but hate the lag that usually comes with it—this is the pack for you!

## 🚀 Key Features
* **Peak Performance:** Fully optimized with modern rendering engines and lag-reduction mods to ensure high FPS even with massive automation lines.
* **The Create Mod:** Build incredible mechanical systems, automated farms, and complex train networks.
* **Quality of Life:** Hand-picked utility mods to improve your inventory management, map navigation, and overall gameplay experience.

## 🛠️ Modlist Highlights
* **Technology:** Create Mod
* **Performance:** Sodium / Lithium / Indium /Iris Shaders etc..
